top_signals.title: How Russia Sees the World Now
top_signals.summary: Dmitry Adamsky, an expert on Russian security and Russian nuclear deterrence strategy at Harvard and Reichman Universities, examines a large-scale shift in Russia’s strategic thinking over the past year, centered around the view that Europe, rather than the United States, is now Russia’s primary geopolitical rival and adversary, and looking at the consequences of this shift for US efforts to end the war in Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Retail Deleveraging Sinks India Small Caps Most Since March
top_signals.summary: A wave of deleveraging by retail investors has triggered the biggest rout in Indian small-cap stocks in seven months, as mounting concerns over inflation and higher interest rates weigh on sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Russia and Ukraine trade fresh strikes despite renewed push for U.S.-brokered peace talks
top_signals.summary: Both Putin and Zelenskyy said Thursday they were open for peace negotiations, even as they continued strikes overnight.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Daimler Truck sues former fleet manager over alleged $3.8M embezzlement
top_signals.summary:
Daimler Truck North America is seeking $6.6 million in damages after accusing a former employee and his wife of misappropriating nearly $3.8 million.
